issue.title: Writing highlights scans hold bob_sync.lock for the whole 80–300 s scan even with nothing to write
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Make writing `bob highlights scan` / `bob ref scan` take `bob_sync.lock` only when intake or writes exist. Plan the library without the maintenance lock, then acquire `bob_sync.lock` (then `scan.lock`) for the write phase, with guarded re-validation so vault-sync still cannot push a library PDF without its ref note.

The current work is plugin-only: album and bank schema saves retry on decoded `lock_busy` for up to 10 minutes. Narrowing how long a writing highlights scan holds `bob_sync.lock` is a bob-cli lock-protocol change in `scan_library`, outside that plugin retry.

## Problem

Writing highlights scans hold `bob_sync.lock` for the whole 80–300 s scan even with nothing to write.

`scan_library` in `src/native/highlights_ref/sync.rs` takes the vault-maintenance lock (`acquire_scan_maintenance_lock`) and then `scan.lock` *before* the pre-scan hook, xlib intake, and parallel planning of every library PDF. Dry runs take neither lock. Writing scans hold both until the function returns, including the common `writes: none` path.

That hold is the bob-cli-9c.1 contract: every writing `bob ref scan` takes `bob_sync.lock` before `scan.lock` and holds both through intake and note writes, so vault-sync cannot push a library PDF without its ref note. `lock_busy` names the maintenance lock path. Preserve that guarantee and the `bob_sync.lock` → `scan.lock` order, or justify a new order.

## Evidence

- Mac `bob-highlights-sync` cron (`:00/:15/:30/:45`) runs a writing `bob highlights scan`. `~/.local/state/cron/bob-highlights-sync.log` shows each run lasting 78–307 s even with `writes: none`. The 2026-11-17 07:00 screencast run went 07:00:00–07:01:32 while an album Schema Card save hit `lock_busy`.
- `host_catalog::run_locked` (`src/native/host_catalog/txn.rs`) waits 3 s (`LOCK_WAIT`) then returns JSON `lock_busy`. Every 3 s-budget writer fails for the whole scan window: album and bank updates, themes, relation labels, attachments, periods, task move.
- Plugin spawn timeout is 20 s (`BOB_SPAWN_TIMEOUT_MS`). Lengthening bob's wait past the longest scan is unsafe: killing bob after it took the lock is an unknown outcome. Plugin-side retry (plan:202611/schema_save_lock_wait.md) waits out contention; it does not shorten the scan hold.

## Design constraints

- Preserve the 9c.1 guarantee: vault-sync must not push a library PDF without its ref note.
- Preserve `bob_sync.lock` → `scan.lock` order, or justify a new order.
- Likely direction: lock-free planning, then take the lock only when intake or writes exist, with guarded re-validation of the plan before write.

Related: closed phase bob-cli-9c.1 (the lock-hold that this would narrow); ready feature bob-cli-mm (schema save latency attribution, a different trim).
